testcase.name: Scenario: Switch compact groups in the right-docked ribbon: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-docking-source/features/application/ribbon-docking/ribbon-docking.feature:267:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Switch compact groups in the right-docked ribbon ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active with the 3D Model ribbon docked on the right ✔ And Modify and Work Features are shown as compact group buttons ✔ When the user selects Modify ✔ Then Modify is highlighted ✔ And its command panel opens to the left of the ribbon ✔ When the user selects Work Features ✔ Then its command panel replaces the Modify panel ✔ And lists Plane, Axis, Point and UCS ✔ When the user docks the ribbon at the top ✔ Then the temporary command panel closes ✔ And the part remains active
